post.description:
## Create Task

Use this endpoint to create a new multimodal video generation task. Use only one generation mode per request.

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
  After submission, use the unified query endpoint to check task progress and retrieve results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend providing the `callBackUrl` parameter so your service can receive completion notifications instead of polling for task status.
:::

## Related Resources

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Model Marketplace" icon="lucide-store" href="/market/quickstart">

  <Card title="Common API" icon="lucide-cog" href="/common-api/get-account-credits">

## Generation modes

Choose one mode per request, based on whether you send a first frame or a video:

| Mode | When | `duration` | Other assets allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A Text / reference images | No `first_frame_url`, no `video_list` | **Required**, integer **3–15** | `image_urls` |
| B First frame only | `first_frame_url` set, no `last_frame_url` | **Required**, integer **3–15** | None (see exclusions) |
| C First and last frame | Both `first_frame_url` and `last_frame_url` | **Required**, integer **3–10** | None (see exclusions) |
| D Video edit | `video_list` set | **Do not send** | `image_urls` |

**Exclusions** (when `first_frame_url` or `last_frame_url` is set):

- Do not send `last_frame_url` alone
- Do not send `image_urls` or `video_list` at the same time

## Image quota (7 slots)

Quota formula:

```
number of reference images
+ (2 if a video is present)
≤ 7
```

Also: `image_urls` max **6**.

**Examples:**

*   6 reference images → allowed
*   5 reference images + 1 video → 5+2=7, allowed
*   6 reference images + 1 video → 6+2=8, over quota

model.description: The model name used to generate the task. This field is required. This interface must use the `google/gemini-omni-flash-1-2` model.

callBackUrl.description: The callback URL for task completion notifications. This parameter is optional. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task is completed, regardless of whether it succeeds or fails. If not provided, no callback notification will be sent.

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task. Use only one generation mode per request: text / reference images, first frame only, first and last frame, or video edit.

prompt.description: Video prompt. Required and must be non-empty. Describe the scene, action, camera, and sound.
examples: A cat plays piano in a jazz bar, one continuous shot, soft live jazz

duration.description:
Duration of the generated video in seconds. Send an integer.

- Text / reference images (no first frame, no video): **required**, **3–15**
- First frame only: **required**, **3–15**
- First and last frame: **required**, **3–10**
- Video edit (`video_list` set): **do not send**; output duration follows the input video

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Allowed values: `16:9`, `9:16`, `auto`. Default `16:9`. When no reference image is provided, `auto` is treated as `16:9`.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. Allowed values: `360p`, `720p`, `1080p`, `4k`. Default `720p`.

seeds.description: Random seed. Range: 10000–99999. Send a single integer. If omitted, the system generates one.

image_urls.description:
Reference image URLs, max **6**. Used for subject, scene, style, or storyboard reference. Two reference images are not treated as first/last frames.

Limits:
- Use publicly accessible image URLs
- Each file must be no larger than `20MB`
- Mutually exclusive with `first_frame_url` and `last_frame_url`
- Each image costs 1 quota slot

first_frame_url.description:
First-frame image URL. Sets the starting frame of the generated video. Use a publicly accessible image URL.

- First frame only (no last frame): `duration` is required, integer 3–15
- Together with `last_frame_url`: `duration` is required, integer 3–10
- When this field is set, do not send `image_urls` or `video_list`
- Do not send `last_frame_url` alone

last_frame_url.description: Last-frame image URL. Sets the ending frame. Must be sent together with `first_frame_url`; cannot be used alone. `duration` is then required and must be 3–10. When first and last frames are set, do not send `image_urls` or `video_list`.

video_list.description: Video URL array, max **1**. Sending this field selects video-edit mode. **Do not send `duration`**; output duration follows the input video. Can be combined with `image_urls`. Mutually exclusive with `first_frame_url` and `last_frame_url`. Use a publicly accessible video URL, MP4 recommended, no longer than **15 seconds**.

input.prompt: The character walks through a rainy street at night, neon reflections

taskId.description: Task ID, which can be used to query task status through the task detail endpoint.

post.description: The system sends this callback when the `google/gemini-omni-flash-1-2` task succeeds or fails.

code.description: Unified callback code: 200 for success, 501 for failure.

model.description: The model used for the task.

param.description: JSON string containing the submitted task parameters.

resultJson.description: JSON string containing resultUrls, firstFrameUrl, lastFrameUrl, or resultObject when successful. Present only when state is success.

failCode.description: Failure code, a numeric string such as "400" or "500". Present only when state is fail.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks.

data.param: {"input":"{\"prompt\":\"The character walks through a rainy street at night, neon reflections\",\"duration\":8,\"aspect_ratio\":\"9:16\",\"resolution\":\"720p\",\"image_urls\":[\"https://example.com/ref1.png\",\"https://example.com/ref2.png\"]}","callBackUrl":"https://example.com/callback","model":"google/gemini-omni-flash-1-2"}

{"input":"{\"prompt\":\"The character walks through a rainy street at night, neon reflections\",\"duration\":8,\"aspect_ratio\":\"9:16\",\"resolution\":\"720p\",\"image_urls\":[\"https://example.com/ref1.png\",\"https://example.com/ref2.png\"]}","callBackUrl":"https://example.com/callback","model":"google/gemini-omni-flash-1-2"}

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description upon failure

taskId.description: The task ID can be used with the "Get Task Details" endpoint to query the task status.

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
